208	                    f"wallet {wallet_id!r} restore transaction cannot be "
209	                    f"reconciled: {exc.message}"
210	                ) from exc
211	            try:
212	                # 跨目录恢复登记（restore-records/）闭集与本钱包记录形状：
213	                # 崩溃可能发生在提交后的登记/清理阶段，闭集外条目（链接、
214	                # 目录、备份、随机临时名）或损坏记录同样不可对账，fail-closed。
215	                drbackup.reconcile_restore_records(
216	                    self._store.data_dir, wallet_id
217	                )
218	            except drbackup.BackupError as exc:
219	                raise RecoveryError(
220	                    f"wallet {wallet_id!r} restore records cannot be "
221	                    f"reconciled: {exc.message}"
222	                ) from exc
223	            # 审计是轮换激活/资产提交/会话动作的唯一提交点：日志形状或
224	            # seq 连续性损坏时任何前滚/回滚判定都不可信，最先 fail-closed。
225	            self._audit.check_log(wallet_id)
226	            # 先校验资产账本（形状 + 语义）：账本损坏时任何对账都不可信，
227	            # 直接 fail-closed。
228	            self._store.check_asset_ledger_semantics(wallet_id)
229	            self._store.recover_wallet_rotation(
230	                wallet_id,
231	                self._activated_rotations(wallet_id),
232	                self._prepared_rotations(wallet_id),
233	            )
234	            self._recover_wallet_asset_commits(wallet_id)
235	            # 意图清零后再做账本 ↔ asset_operation_committed 事件的双向
236	            # 对账：提交事件与 committed 操作必须一一对应、details 即 R。
237	            self._reconcile_asset_committed_events(wallet_id)
238	            self._recover_sign_sessions(wallet_id)
239	        except RecoveryError:
240	            raise
241	        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
242	            raise RecoveryError(
243	                f"wallet {wallet_id!r} cannot be reconciled: {exc}"
244	            ) from exc

246	    def _heal_wallet(self, wallet_id: str) -> None:
247	        """持锁后自愈他进程崩溃遗留的现场（懒恢复，fail-closed）。
248	
249	        常驻进程不会重跑启动恢复；为使任何查询/重放永远读不到他进程
250	        留下的半完成激活或半完成提交，业务操作在拿到钱包事务锁后先调用
251	        本方法。在途事务必持同锁，故这里看到的残留只能来自崩溃进程：
252	
253	        - 资产提交意图残留：按提交事件是否落盘前滚或回滚；
254	        - activating 记录：激活事务窗口内的残留，按激活事件前滚/回滚；
255	        - active 记录但暂存/备份仍残留、或激活事件缺失：崩溃现场，
256	          按事件前滚补齐或（事件在却无法补齐时）fail-closed；
257	        - 无任何记录对应的孤儿暂存目录：安全删除。
258	
259	        静止现场不触发恢复：prepared（暂存完整待激活）与干净完成的
260	        active（事件在、暂存已清空）。对账失败向上抛出
261	        RecoveryError/OSError，绝不静默继续。检测读取本身遇到损坏 JSON/
262	        形状异常（ValueError）时无法判断现场是否静止，按不可对账处理，
263	        交由 _recover_wallet fail-closed。
264	        """
265	        try:
266	            # 灾备恢复事务的崩溃残留优先收敛（committed 前滚/否则整体回滚），
267	            # 再进入账本/会话/轮换的静止快路径：替换窗口内现场可能新旧混杂。
268	            # restore-txn 根一出现（哪怕不属于本钱包、或根自身/根下有任何
269	            # 非安全项）就进入完整恢复：根目录闭集校验在恢复路径内统一
270	            # fail-closed，绝不让持锁访问绕过不可对账的灾备现场。
271	            import os as _os
272	
273	            from . import drbackup
274	
275	            _txn_root = _os.path.join(
276	                self._store.data_dir, drbackup.RESTORE_TXN_DIRNAME
277	            )
278	            if _os.path.lexists(_txn_root):
279	                self._recover_wallet(wallet_id)
280	                return
281	            # 即便没有 restore-txn（提交后的清理已完成，或强杀发生在登记
282	            # 阶段），跨目录登记根 restore-records/ 仍须闭集可信：链接、目录、
283	            # 备份、随机临时名或损坏的本钱包记录都 fail-closed，绝不让持锁
284	            # 访问绕过不可对账的登记现场。
285	            try:
286	                drbackup.reconcile_restore_records(
287	                    self._store.data_dir, wallet_id
288	                )
289	            except drbackup.BackupError as exc:
290	                raise RecoveryError(
291	                    f"wallet {wallet_id!r} restore records cannot be "
292	                    f"reconciled: {exc.message}"
293	                ) from exc
294	            # 资产账本是所有创建/提交/查询/审计读路径的依赖：形状或语义
295	            # 损坏时无法与意图/事件对账，绝不能静默当成空账本。任何持锁
296	            # 访问都先校验账本，损坏即由 _recover_wallet 统一 fail-closed。
297	            self._store.check_asset_ledger_semantics(wallet_id)
298	            # 签名会话文件形状损坏同样 fail-closed，绝不把坏会话当空会话。
299	            # 这里只做形状校验；会话对账必须排在轮换/资产恢复之后——会话
300	            # 迁移依据"当前在用份额"，而他进程崩溃遗留的半完成激活可能仍
301	            # 持有错误的钱包份额，必须先按激活事件前滚/回滚确定在用份额，
302	            # 再对账会话，避免把会话迁移到未提交轮换的份额上。
303	            self._store.check_sign_sessions(wallet_id)
304	            if self._store.list_asset_intents(wallet_id):
305	                self._recover_wallet(wallet_id)
306	                return
307	            rotations = self._store.list_rotations(wallet_id)
308	            staging_ids = set(self._store.list_staging_rotation_ids(wallet_id))
309	            needs_recovery = False
310	            active_check = False
311	            for record in rotations:
312	                state = record.get("state")
313	                rid = record.get("rotation_id")
314	                if state == "activating":
315	                    needs_recovery = True
316	                elif state == "active":
317	                    # 干净完成的 active：事件在且暂存已清空。暂存残留或
318	                    # 事件缺失才是崩溃现场（后者需读审计判定）。
319	                    if rid in staging_ids:
320	                        needs_recovery = True
321	                    else:
322	                        active_check = True
323	                elif state == "prepared" and isinstance(rid, str):
324	                    # prepared 的暂存目录是预期现场，不算孤儿
325	                    staging_ids.discard(rid)
326	            if not needs_recovery and active_check:
327	                activated = self._activated_rotations(wallet_id)
328	                for record in rotations:
329	                    if (
330	                        record.get("state") == "active"
331	                        and record.get("rotation_id") not in activated
332	                    ):
333	                        needs_recovery = True
334	                        break
335	            if not needs_recovery and (rotations or staging_ids):
336	                # 看似静止也要按审计 seq 对账一次激活链：连续多轮轮换后，
337	                # 历史记录缺失、链乱序/跨轮次不相容、链顶公钥/份额与磁盘
338	                # 不符等矛盾不会体现为 activating/暂存残留，必须在此拦住，
339	                # 绝不带矛盾现场对外服务。
340	                if not active_check:
341	                    activated = self._activated_rotations(wallet_id)
342	                if not self._store.verify_rotation_scene_consistent(
343	                    wallet_id,
344	                    activated,
345	                    self._prepared_rotations(wallet_id),
346	                ):
347	                    needs_recovery = True
348	            if not needs_recovery and staging_ids:
349	                # 无对应 prepared 记录的孤儿暂存目录
350	                needs_recovery = True
351	            if needs_recovery:
352	                # 内含轮换 -> 资产提交 -> 会话的完整有序恢复
353	                self._recover_wallet(wallet_id)
354	                return
355	            # 轮换现场静止后，再对他进程崩溃遗留的半完成会话对账（无会话
356	            # 文件时立即返回，零开销；此时读取审计不影响审计无关路由）。
357	            # 账本文件存在时同理做账本 ↔ committed 事件对账：只有存在
358	            # 账本现场时才需要读取审计，保持"无业务文件的纯钱包不依赖
359	            # 审计日志"的既有可用性边界。
360	            if self._store.asset_ledger_file_exists(wallet_id):
361	                self._reconcile_asset_committed_events(wallet_id)
362	            self._recover_sign_sessions(wallet_id)
363	        except RecoveryError:
364	            raise
365	        except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
366	            # 检测/对账阶段读到无法解析的现场：不能假定静止，fail-closed
367	            raise RecoveryError(
368	                f"wallet {wallet_id!r} cannot be reconciled: {exc}"
369	            ) from exc

394	    def create_wallet(self, wallet_id: object, shares: object) -> dict:
395	        if not isinstance(wallet_id, str) or not wallet_id:
396	            raise ServiceError(400, "wallet_id must be a non-empty string")
397	        # bool 是 int 的子类，必须先排除；2.0 == 2，必须要求真正的 int
398	        if not isinstance(shares, int) or isinstance(shares, bool):
399	            raise ServiceError(400, "shares must equal 2")
400	        if shares != REQUIRED_SHARES:
401	            raise ServiceError(400, "shares must equal 2")
402	        try:
403	            share_keys = [crypto.generate_share_key(sid) for sid in SHARE_IDS]
404	            # 跨进程防重：同一 data-dir 上多个服务进程并发建同名钱包时，
405	            # 只有一个能在事务锁内提交成功
406	            with self._wallet_lock(wallet_id):
407	                self._store.create_wallet(
408	                    wallet_id, share_keys, _utc_now_iso()
409	                )
410	        except DuplicateWalletError:
411	            raise ServiceError(409, f"wallet {wallet_id!r} already exists")
412	        except ValueError:
413	            # wallet_id 含非法字符
414	            raise ServiceError(400, "invalid wallet_id")
415	        public_key = crypto.combine_public_keys(
416	            [k.public_bytes for k in share_keys]
417	        )
418	        return {
419	            "wallet_id": wallet_id,
420	            "public_key": public_key.hex(),
421	            "share_ids": list(SHARE_IDS),
422	        }

428	            with self._wallet_lock(wallet_id):
429	                # 查询前先自愈他进程崩溃遗留的激活现场，绝不把换了一半
430	                # 的公钥/份额经 GET 暴露出去
431	                self._heal_wallet(wallet_id)

440	        return {

444	        }

446	    def share_sign(
447	        self,
448	        wallet_id: str,
449	        share_id: object,
450	        signing_request_id: object,
451	        message: object,
452	    ) -> dict:
453	        """份额持有方本地签名（CLI share-sign 专用，不经网络）。
454	
455	        在该钱包的事务锁内先做懒恢复（``_heal_wallet``），再依据钱包
456	        元数据中当前在用的 share_id 读取份额私钥并签名：绝不在轮换激活
457	        半完成、或份额已轮换失效时读到半换入/已删除的份额。恢复无法
458	        对账时向上抛 RecoveryError/OSError（fail-closed），由调用方输出
459	        JSON 错误并非零退出。
460	
461	        份额文件损坏（JSON 不可解析、非对象、字段缺失、私钥非 hex、长度
462	        非法）或私钥推导不出记录中的份额公钥（被篡改）时，绝不基于不一致
463	        的密钥签名：统一抛 ServiceError(503) 与不含私钥/载荷的泛化信息。
464	        """
465	        if (
466	            not isinstance(signing_request_id, str)
467	            or not signing_request_id
468	        ):
469	            raise ServiceError(
470	                400, "signing_request_id must be a non-empty string"
471	            )
472	        if not isinstance(message, str):
473	            raise ServiceError(400, "message must be a string")
474	        with self._wallet_lock(wallet_id):
475	            # 懒恢复可能抛 RecoveryError/OSError（fail-closed），保持上抛。
476	            self._heal_wallet(wallet_id)
477	            try:
478	                wallet = self._store.get_wallet(wallet_id)
479	            except CorruptDataError:
480	                raise
481	            except ValueError:
482	                raise ServiceError(400, "invalid wallet_id")
483	            if wallet is None:
484	                raise ServiceError(404, f"wallet {wallet_id!r} not found")
485	            in_use = {
486	                s.get("share_id"): s.get("public_key")
487	                for s in wallet.get("shares", [])
488	                if isinstance(s, dict)
489	            }
490	            if not isinstance(share_id, str) or share_id not in in_use:
491	                raise ServiceError(
492	                    404,
493	                    f"share {share_id!r} of wallet {wallet_id!r} not found",
494	                )
495	            try:
496	                share = self._store.get_share(wallet_id, share_id)
497	            except CorruptDataError:
498	                # 份额文件损坏：由下方完整性校验统一报泛化 503
499	                share = None
500	            except ValueError:
501	                raise ServiceError(400, "invalid share_id")
502	            # 份额完整性校验：任何形状/编码/长度/密钥对应关系异常都视为
503	            # 数据损坏，fail-closed，绝不读出私钥盲目签名，也绝不把底层
504	            # 异常文本、私钥或签名载荷暴露给调用方。
505	            private_bytes = self._load_share_private_bytes(
506	                share, expected_share_id=share_id,
507	                expected_public_hex=in_use[share_id],
508	            )
509	            payload = crypto.build_payload(signing_request_id, message)
510	            try:
511	                signature = crypto.sign_share(private_bytes, payload)
512	            except (ValueError, TypeError):
513	                # 理论上 32 字节私钥不会触发，仍兜底避免 traceback
514	                raise ServiceError(
515	                    503, "share is unavailable, refusing to sign"
516	                )
517	            return {"share_id": share_id, "signature": signature.hex()}
518	
519	    @staticmethod
520	    def _load_share_private_bytes(
521	        share: object, *, expected_share_id: str, expected_public_hex: object
522	    ) -> bytes:
523	        """从份额记录中取出经一致性校验的 32 字节私钥。
524	
525	        校验记录为对象、share_id 一致、public_key/private_key 均为字符串、
526	        各自解码为 32 字节、私钥推导出的公钥恰为记录/在用公钥。任一不满足
527	        都抛 ServiceError(503) 泛化错误（数据损坏或被篡改），不含私钥。"""
528	        generic = "share is unavailable, refusing to sign"
529	        if not isinstance(share, dict):
530	            raise ServiceError(503, generic)
531	        if share.get("share_id") != expected_share_id:
532	            raise ServiceError(503, generic)
533	        public_hex = share.get("public_key")
534	        private_hex = share.get("private_key")
535	        if not isinstance(public_hex, str) or not isinstance(private_hex, str):
536	            raise ServiceError(503, generic)
537	        try:
538	            public_bytes = bytes.fromhex(public_hex)
539	            private_bytes = bytes.fromhex(private_hex)
540	        except ValueError:
541	            raise ServiceError(503, generic)
542	        if len(public_bytes) != 32 or len(private_bytes) != 32:
543	            raise ServiceError(503, generic)
544	        try:
545	            derived = crypto.public_key_from_private(private_bytes)
546	        except (ValueError, TypeError):
547	            raise ServiceError(503, generic)
548	        if derived != public_bytes:
549	            raise ServiceError(503, generic)
550	        # 份额记录的公钥还必须与钱包元数据中当前在用公钥一致
551	        if not isinstance(expected_public_hex, str):
552	            raise ServiceError(503, generic)
553	        try:
554	            in_use_public = bytes.fromhex(expected_public_hex)
555	        except ValueError:
556	            raise ServiceError(503, generic)
557	        if in_use_public != public_bytes:
558	            raise ServiceError(503, generic)
559	        return private_bytes

576	    def put_policy(
577	        self,
578	        wallet_id: str,
579	        required_approvals: object,
580	        timeout_seconds: object,
581	    ) -> dict:
582	        # 读取（钱包存在性、旧策略）、校验、持久化与事件追加全部在同一把
583	        # 每钱包事务锁内完成：多个 serve 进程并发更新同一钱包策略时，
584	        # operation(created|updated) 严格依据锁内旧值，policy_updated 的
585	        # seq 顺序即策略线性化顺序，绝不基于锁外陈旧快照判定。
586	        policy: dict | None = None
587	        try:
588	            with self._wallet_lock(wallet_id):
589	                self._heal_wallet(wallet_id)
590	                # 404 优先于 400：钱包存在性在锁内先于参数校验
591	                self._get_wallet_or_404(wallet_id)
592	                # bool 是 int 的子类，必须先排除
593	                if (
594	                    not isinstance(required_approvals, int)
595	                    or isinstance(required_approvals, bool)
596	                    or required_approvals not in ALLOWED_REQUIRED_APPROVALS
597	                ):
598	                    raise ServiceError(
599	                        400,
600	                        "required_approvals must be one of "
601	                        + ", ".join(str(v) for v in ALLOWED_REQUIRED_APPROVALS),
602	                    )
603	                if (
604	                    not isinstance(timeout_seconds, int)
605	                    or isinstance(timeout_seconds, bool)
606	                    or timeout_seconds <= 0
607	                ):
608	                    raise ServiceError(
609	                        400, "timeout_seconds must be a positive integer"
610	                    )
611	                policy = {
612	                    "wallet_id": wallet_id,
613	                    "required_approvals": required_approvals,
614	                    "timeout_seconds": timeout_seconds,
615	                }
616	                # 同值更新也成功并记录；operation 必须依据锁内旧值
617	                old_policy = self._store.get_policy(wallet_id)
618	                operation = "created" if old_policy is None else "updated"
619	                self._store.save_policy(wallet_id, policy)
620	                event = self._audit_event(
621	                    audit.TYPE_POLICY_UPDATED,
622	                    details={
623	                        "required_approvals": required_approvals,
624	                        "timeout_seconds": timeout_seconds,
625	                        "operation": operation,
626	                    },
627	                )
628	                try:
629	                    self._emit(wallet_id, event)
630	                except BaseException:
631	                    # 状态/事件原子：事件未落盘则回滚策略状态

665	        if not isinstance(allowed_assets, list) or not allowed_assets:

683	    def put_transaction_policy(
684	        self,
685	        wallet_id: str,
686	        mode: object,
687	        max_delta: object,
688	        allowed_assets: object,
689	    ) -> dict:
690	        """设置（或覆盖）钱包的冷热钱包交易策略。
691	
692	        成功 200 返回与请求体同形的 {mode, max_delta, allowed_assets}；
693	        钱包不存在 404；类型、空值、重复或非法资产 400。策略状态与
694	        transaction_policy_updated 事件在每钱包事务锁内原子持久化，
695	        同值更新也记事件（details 即策略三项）。
696	
697	        恢复检查、钱包存在性判定、参数校验、旧策略读取、覆盖与事件追加
698	        全部在同一把每钱包跨进程事务锁内完成：绝不基于锁外快照决定
699	        404/400 或判定旧值，策略与资产首签/创建交错时只能看到锁提交时
700	        已生效的策略。
701	        """
702	        policy: dict | None = None
703	        try:
704	            with self._wallet_lock(wallet_id):
705	                self._heal_wallet(wallet_id)
706	                # 404 优先于 400：存在性在锁内、heal 之后先判定
707	                self._get_wallet_or_404(wallet_id)
708	                self._validate_transaction_policy(mode, max_delta, allowed_assets)
709	                # 落盘文件恰含 mode/max_delta/allowed_assets 三项（公开契约）
710	                policy = {
711	                    "mode": mode,
712	                    "max_delta": max_delta,
713	                    "allowed_assets": list(allowed_assets),
714	                }
715	                old_policy = self._store.get_transaction_policy(wallet_id)
716	                self._store.save_transaction_policy(wallet_id, policy)
717	                event = self._audit_event(
718	                    audit.TYPE_TRANSACTION_POLICY_UPDATED,
719	                    details={
720	                        "mode": mode,
721	                        "max_delta": max_delta,
722	                        "allowed_assets": list(allowed_assets),
723	                    },
724	                )
725	                try:
726	                    self._emit(wallet_id, event)
727	                except BaseException:
728	                    # 状态/事件原子：事件未落盘则回滚策略状态
729	                    if old_policy is None:
730	                        self._store.delete_transaction_policy(wallet_id)
731	                    else:
732	                        self._store.save_transaction_policy(
733	                            wallet_id, old_policy
734	                        )
735	                    raise
736	        except CorruptDataError:
737	            # 钱包元数据/旧策略损坏：fail-closed（由 HTTP 边界转 503）
738	            raise
739	        except ValueError:
740	            # wallet_id 含非法字符（构造锁路径时抛出）
741	            raise ServiceError(400, "invalid wallet_id")
742	        # 对外视图与请求体同形（不含 wallet_id）
743	        return {
744	            "mode": policy["mode"],
745	            "max_delta": policy["max_delta"],
746	            "allowed_assets": list(policy["allowed_assets"]),
747	        }

792	        """懒过期：任何操作前把已超时的 pending 单持久化为 expired，
793	        并原子记录一次 request_expired 事件。调用方须持有该钱包事务锁。

797	        ):

802	                self._emit(
803	                    wallet_id,
804	                    self._audit_event(
805	                        audit.TYPE_REQUEST_EXPIRED,
806	                        request_id=record["id"],
807	                        details={"state": "expired"},
808	                    ),
809	                )
810	            except BaseException:

843	    def create_sign_request(
844	        self, wallet_id: str, request_id: object, message: object
845	    ) -> tuple[int, dict]:
846	        """返回 (HTTP 状态码, 响应体)。
847	
848	        读取、校验、幂等判定、策略读取、req/t0/t1 取值与持久化、事件追加
849	        全部在同一把每钱包事务锁内完成。多个 serve 进程并发更新同一钱包
850	        审批策略与创建签名请求时，请求单只能采用**锁提交时已生效**的
851	        required_approvals/timeout_seconds；锁内判定仍无审批策略则 409 且
852	        不留下请求或事件；request_created 与 policy_updated 的 seq 顺序即
853	        该钱包的线性化顺序。
854	        """
855	        record: dict | None = None
856	        try:
857	            with self._wallet_lock(wallet_id):
858	                self._heal_wallet(wallet_id)
859	                # 404 优先于 400：钱包存在性在锁内先于请求体/id 校验
860	                self._get_wallet_or_404(wallet_id)
861	                self._validate_request_body(request_id, message)
862	                # 锁内查重：同 id 同文 200、异文 409 均不记事件、不改状态，
863	                # 也不依赖此刻是否仍有策略（既有幂等语义保持）。
864	                try:
865	                    existing = self._store.get_request(
866	                        wallet_id, request_id
867	                    )
868	                except CorruptDataError:
869	                    # 审批单文件损坏：fail-closed（由 HTTP 边界转 503）
870	                    raise
871	                except ValueError:
872	                    raise ServiceError(400, "invalid signing_request_id")
873	                if existing is not None:
874	                    # POST 不是懒过期触发点：原样返回磁盘中持久化的状态
875	                    # （pending/approved/rejected/expired/signed），绝不在响应里
876	                    # 把磁盘仍是 pending 的单临时呈现成 expired。
877	                    if existing["message"] != message:
878	                        raise ServiceError(
879	                            409,
880	                            f"signing request {request_id!r} already exists "
881	                            "with a different message",
882	                        )
883	                    return 200, self._request_view(existing)
884	                # 首次创建：按锁提交时刻已生效的策略决定可否建单与参数。
885	                # 锁内判定仍无策略：409 且不留下任何请求或事件。
886	                policy = self._store.get_policy(wallet_id)
887	                if policy is None:
888	                    raise ServiceError(
889	                        409, f"wallet {wallet_id!r} has no approval policy"
890	                    )
891	                now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
892	                record = {
893	                    "id": request_id,
894	                    "message": message,
895	                    "state": "pending",
896	                    "approvers": [],
897	                    "req": policy["required_approvals"],
898	                    "t0": now.isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z"),
899	                    "t1": (now + timedelta(seconds=policy["timeout_seconds"]))
900	                    .isoformat()
901	                    .replace("+00:00", "Z"),
902	                    "reason": None,
903	                }
904	                # 锁内已确认不存在；存储层仍原子查重兜底
905	                self._store.create_request(wallet_id, request_id, record)
906	                # 首次创建：状态 + C 事件原子
907	                event = self._audit_event(
908	                    audit.TYPE_REQUEST_CREATED,
909	                    request_id=request_id,
910	                    details={"message": message},
911	                )
912	                try:
913	                    self._emit(wallet_id, event)
914	                except BaseException:
915	                    self._store.delete_request(wallet_id, request_id)
916	                    raise
917	        except CorruptDataError:
918	            # 钱包元数据/审批单/策略损坏：fail-closed（由 HTTP 边界转 503）
919	            raise
920	        except ValueError:
921	            # wallet_id 含非法字符（构造锁路径时抛出）
922	            raise ServiceError(400, "invalid wallet_id")
923	        return 201, self._request_view(record)
924	
925	    def get_sign_request(self, wallet_id: str, request_id: str) -> dict:
926	        try:
927	            with self._wallet_lock(wallet_id):
928	                self._heal_wallet(wallet_id)
929	                # 钱包存在性、审批单读取与懒过期全部在锁内：绝不先用锁外
930	                # 快照决定 404，也读不到并发事务半完成的审批单状态。
931	                self._get_wallet_or_404(wallet_id)
932	                record = self._fetch_request_or_404(wallet_id, request_id)
933	                record = self._expire_if_needed(wallet_id, record)
934	                return self._request_view(record)
935	        except CorruptDataError:
936	            raise
937	        except ValueError:

943	    AUDIT_DEFAULT_LIMIT = 1000
944	    AUDIT_MAX_LIMIT = 1000
945	
946	    @staticmethod
947	    def _parse_positive_int(value: object, name: str) -> int:
948	        """from_seq/limit 必须是正整数（bool/浮点/带符号/缺失均拒绝）。"""
949	        if isinstance(value, str):
950	            text = value.strip()
951	            if not text.isdigit():
952	                raise ServiceError(400, f"{name} must be a positive integer")
953	            value = int(text)
954	        if (
955	            not isinstance(value, int)
956	            or isinstance(value, bool)
957	            or value < 1
958	        ):
959	            raise ServiceError(400, f"{name} must be a positive integer")
960	        return value

962	    def get_audit_events(
963	        self,
964	        wallet_id: str,
965	        from_seq: object = None,
966	        limit: object = None,
967	    ) -> dict:
968	        """返回 {wallet_id, events}（seq 升序）。
969	
970	        纯只读：不触发 pending 审批单懒过期、不写任何状态/事件、不分配
971	        seq。但与其他所有访问钱包状态的路由一致，必须在该钱包事务锁内
972	        先自愈他进程崩溃遗留的轮换/资产提交残留，再读取审计：恢复无法
973	        对账（RecoveryError/OSError/CorruptDataError）时由调用方转 503，
974	        绝不返回可能半完成的公钥/余额/version 之外的不一致现场。
975	
976	        存在性判定、分页参数校验与审计读取全部在锁内：绝不先用锁外
977	        快照决定 404/400，也读不到并发事务半完成状态。"""
978	        try:
979	            with self._wallet_lock(wallet_id):
980	                self._heal_wallet(wallet_id)
981	                # 404 优先于 400：锁内先判定钱包存在，再校验分页参数
982	                self._get_wallet_or_404(wallet_id)
983	                seq = (
984	                    1
985	                    if from_seq is None
986	                    else self._parse_positive_int(from_seq, "from_seq")
987	                )
988	                size = (
989	                    self.AUDIT_DEFAULT_LIMIT
990	                    if limit is None
991	                    else self._parse_positive_int(limit, "limit")
992	                )
993	                if size > self.AUDIT_MAX_LIMIT:
994	                    raise ServiceError(
995	                        400, f"limit must be at most {self.AUDIT_MAX_LIMIT}"
996	                    )
997	                # 只读自愈：把可恢复的崩溃现场对账到一致，但绝不记事件、
998	                # 绝不触发审批单懒过期。
999	                events = self._audit.list_events(
1000	                    wallet_id, from_seq=seq, limit=size
1001	                )
1002	        except CorruptDataError:
1003	            raise
1004	        except ValueError:
1005	            # wallet_id 含非法字符（构造锁路径时抛出）；from_seq/limit 的
1006	            # 非法值已在锁内转成 ServiceError(400)
1007	            raise ServiceError(400, "invalid wallet_id")
1008	        return {"wallet_id": wallet_id, "events": events}

1088	                                "private_key": key.private_bytes.hex(),
1089	                            },
1090	                        )
1091	                    self._store.create_rotation(wallet_id, rotation_id, record)
1092	                    self._emit(
1093	                        wallet_id,
1094	                        self._audit_event(
1095	                            audit.TYPE_SHARE_ROTATION_PREPARED,
1096	                            details={
1097	                                "rotation_id": rotation_id,
1098	                                "share_ids": share_ids,
1099	                                "public_key": public_key,
1100	                            },
1101	                        ),
1102	                    )
1103	                except BaseException:

1110	        except ValueError:

1304	    def create_asset_operation(
1305	        self,
1306	        wallet_id: str,
1307	        operation_id: object,
1308	        asset_id: object,
1309	        delta: object,
1310	    ) -> tuple[int, dict]:
1311	        """创建一条资产操作（pending）。返回 (HTTP 状态码, 响应体 R)。
1312	
1313	        首次创建 201；同 operation_id 同参数幂等重放 200（返回当前记录，
1314	        不重复记事件、不再按当前策略校验）；同 operation_id 异参数 409。
1315	        创建本身不记审计事件。
1316	
1317	        钱包配置了冷热钱包交易策略时，**仅首次创建**按创建时刻的策略
1318	        检查：asset_id 必须在 allowed_assets 白名单内且
1319	        ``abs(delta) <= max_delta``，否则 409 且账本/version/状态/审计/
1320	        幂等结果均不变（检查发生在任何写入之前）。策略后续更新不影响
1321	        已存在的 pending 操作；未配置策略时行为完全不变。
1322	
1323	        恢复检查、钱包存在性、参数校验、幂等查重与策略读取全部在锁内：
1324	        绝不基于锁外快照决定 404/400/409、重放或白名单结果。
1325	        """
1326	        record: dict | None = None
1327	        try:
1328	            with self._wallet_lock(wallet_id):
1329	                # 快照前先自愈他进程崩溃遗留的提交意图，balance/version 才准确
1330	                self._heal_wallet(wallet_id)
1331	                # 404 优先于 400：存在性先于 id/delta 校验
1332	                self._get_wallet_or_404(wallet_id)
1333	                self._validate_operation_id(operation_id)
1334	                self._validate_asset_id(asset_id)
1335	                self._validate_delta(delta)
1336	                existing = self._store.get_asset_operation(
1337	                    wallet_id, operation_id
1338	                )
1339	                if existing is not None:
1340	                    # 重放：原样返回磁盘中的当前记录，不按更新后的策略重新
1341	                    # 校验、不改状态、不记事件（幂等结果不变）
1342	                    if (
1343	                        existing.get("asset_id") != asset_id
1344	                        or existing.get("delta") != delta
1345	                    ):
1346	                        raise ServiceError(
1347	                            409,
1348	                            f"asset operation {operation_id!r} already exists "
1349	                            "with different parameters",
1350	                        )
1351	                    return 200, existing
1352	                # 首次创建：按锁提交时刻的交易策略检查白名单与单笔上限
1353	                policy = self._store.get_transaction_policy(wallet_id)
1354	                if policy is not None:
1355	                    if asset_id not in policy["allowed_assets"]:
1356	                        raise ServiceError(
1357	                            409,
1358	                            f"asset {asset_id!r} is not allowed by the "
1359	                            "transaction policy",
1360	                        )
1361	                    if abs(delta) > policy["max_delta"]:
1362	                        raise ServiceError(
1363	                            409,
1364	                            f"abs(delta)={abs(delta)} exceeds transaction "
1365	                            f"policy max_delta={policy['max_delta']}",
1366	                        )
1367	                # R 的 balance/version 快照资产在创建时刻的账本状态
1368	                asset = self._store.get_asset(wallet_id, asset_id)
1369	                record = {
1370	                    "operation_id": operation_id,
1371	                    "asset_id": asset_id,
1372	                    "state": "pending",
1373	                    "delta": delta,
1374	                    "balance": asset["balance"] if asset is not None else 0,
1375	                    "version": asset["version"] if asset is not None else 0,
1376	                }
1377	                # 锁内已确认不存在；存储层仍原子查重兜底
1378	                self._store.create_asset_operation(
1379	                    wallet_id, operation_id, record
1380	                )
1381	        except CorruptDataError:
1382	            raise
1383	        except ValueError:
1384	            # wallet_id 含非法字符（构造锁路径时抛出）
1385	            raise ServiceError(400, "invalid wallet_id")
1386	        return 201, record

1390	    def _recover_wallet_asset_commits(self, wallet_id: str) -> None:
1391	        """恢复某钱包全部未完成的资产提交事务（调用方须持有钱包事务锁）。
1392	
1393	        以 asset_operation_committed 事件是否已持久化作为唯一提交判据：
1394	        - 事件在：提交已生效，按事件 details（即 committed 视图 R）把账本
1395	          前滚补齐为一致的 committed 结果，再删意图（幂等，余额/版本按 R
1396	          绝对值校正，不重复应用 delta）；
1397	        - 事件不在：提交未生效，按意图记录的提交前快照把操作恢复为
1398	          pending、资产恢复提交前 balance/version（提交前不存在则删除
1399	          资产条目），再删意图。事件从未分配 seq，故无 seq 缺口。
1400	        恢复本身不记任何审计事件。任一条意图无法对账到一致状态都抛
1401	        RecoveryError，由调用方阻止就绪/返回 503，绝不静默跳过。
1402	        """
1403	        for operation_id, intent in self._store.list_asset_intents(wallet_id):
1404	            self._resolve_asset_commit_intent(wallet_id, operation_id, intent)

1406	    def _reconcile_asset_committed_events(self, wallet_id: str) -> None:
1407	        """账本 committed 操作与 asset_operation_committed 事件双向对账
1408	        （调用方须持钱包事务锁；意图残留须已先恢复清零）。
1409	
1410	        唯一提交点是审计事件：
1411	
1412	        - 每条 committed 操作必须恰有一条同 request_id 的事件，
1413	          ``details`` 与账本中的 committed 视图 R 逐字段一致；
1414	        - 每条 committed 事件必须对应一条账本 committed 操作
1415	          （有事件无操作＝事件被半应用或历史被删，fail-closed）；
1416	        - pending 操作不得有 committed 事件；
1417	        - 同一 operation_id 出现多条 committed 事件＝重复提交点，
1418	          fail-closed。
1419	
1420	        审计日志损坏（CorruptDataError）同样向上抛出，由调用方 fail-closed。
1421	        """
1422	        ledger = self._store.check_asset_ledger_semantics(wallet_id)
1423	        committed_ops: dict[str, dict] = {
1424	            op_id: record
1425	            for op_id, record in ledger["operations"].items()
1426	            if record["state"] == "committed"
1427	        }
1428	        pending_ops = {
1429	            op_id
1430	            for op_id, record in ledger["operations"].items()
1431	            if record["state"] == "pending"
1432	        }
1433	        events = self._audit.events_by_type(
1434	            wallet_id, audit.TYPE_ASSET_OPERATION_COMMITTED
1435	        )
1436	        events_by_op: dict[str, dict] = {}
1437	        for event in events:
1438	            op_id = event.get("request_id")
1439	            details = event.get("details")
1440	            if not isinstance(op_id, str):
1441	                raise RecoveryError(
1442	                    f"wallet {wallet_id!r} has an asset_operation_committed "
1443	                    "event without an operation id"
1444	                )
1445	            if op_id in events_by_op:
1446	                # 重复提交点：绝不任取一条
1447	                raise RecoveryError(
1448	                    f"wallet {wallet_id!r} has multiple committed events for "
1449	                    f"asset operation {op_id!r}"
1450	                )
1451	            if (
1452	                not isinstance(details, dict)
1453	                or details.get("operation_id") != op_id
1454	                or not isinstance(details.get("asset_id"), str)
1455	                or not isinstance(details.get("delta"), int)
1456	                or isinstance(details.get("delta"), bool)
1457	                or details.get("delta") == 0
1458	                or details.get("state") != "committed"
1459	                or not isinstance(details.get("balance"), int)
1460	                or isinstance(details.get("balance"), bool)
1461	                or not isinstance(details.get("version"), int)
1462	                or isinstance(details.get("version"), bool)
1463	            ):
1464	                raise RecoveryError(
1465	                    f"wallet {wallet_id!r} committed event for {op_id!r} is "
1466	                    "malformed"
1467	                )
1468	            events_by_op[op_id] = event
1469	            if op_id in pending_ops:
1470	                raise RecoveryError(
1471	                    f"wallet {wallet_id!r} asset operation {op_id!r} is "
1472	                    "pending but has a committed event"
1473	                )
1474	            record = committed_ops.get(op_id)
1475	            if record is None:
1476	                raise RecoveryError(
1477	                    f"wallet {wallet_id!r} has a committed event for "
1478	                    f"{op_id!r} but no committed ledger operation"
1479	                )
1480	            if details != record:
1481	                raise RecoveryError(
1482	                    f"wallet {wallet_id!r} committed event for {op_id!r} "
1483	                    "does not match the ledger record"
1484	                )
1485	        if set(committed_ops) != set(events_by_op):
1486	            missing = sorted(set(committed_ops) - set(events_by_op))
1487	            raise RecoveryError(
1488	                f"wallet {wallet_id!r} committed operations {missing!r} have "
1489	                "no committed event"
1490	            )

1492	    def _resolve_asset_commit_intent(
1493	        self, wallet_id: str, operation_id: str, intent: object
1494	    ) -> Optional[dict]:
1495	        """对账单条提交意图，返回 committed 视图 R（前滚）或 None（回滚）。"""
1496	        # 无论提交事件是否已落盘，损坏/非对象/缺少恢复所需标识与整数的
1497	        # 意图都无法安全对账：先 fail-closed 并保留意图现场原样，绝不借
1498	        # "事件在即可前滚"之名把损坏意图删除或继续提交/回滚/清理。
1499	        if not self._store.valid_asset_commit_intent(operation_id, intent):
1500	            raise RecoveryError(
1501	                f"wallet {wallet_id!r} asset operation {operation_id!r} "
1502	                "commit intent is missing or malformed and cannot be reconciled"
1503	            )
1504	        event = self._audit.find_event_by_request(
1505	            wallet_id,
1506	            audit.TYPE_ASSET_OPERATION_COMMITTED,
1507	            operation_id,
1508	        )
1509	        if event is not None:
1510	            details = event.get("details")
1511	            asset_id = details.get("asset_id") if isinstance(details, dict) else None
1512	            balance = details.get("balance") if isinstance(details, dict) else None
1513	            version = details.get("version") if isinstance(details, dict) else None
1514	            delta = details.get("delta") if isinstance(details, dict) else None
1515	            # 仅当前滚目标是形状完整的 R 时才补齐；事件损坏（原子写使
1516	            # 正常崩溃不会出现，此处只防御外部篡改）无法安全对账，fail-closed。
1517	            if (
1518	                not isinstance(details, dict)
1519	                or not isinstance(asset_id, str)
1520	                or not isinstance(delta, int)
1521	                or isinstance(delta, bool)
1522	                or not isinstance(balance, int)
1523	                or isinstance(balance, bool)
1524	                or not isinstance(version, int)
1525	                or isinstance(version, bool)
1526	            ):
1527	                raise RecoveryError(
1528	                    f"wallet {wallet_id!r} asset operation "
1529	                    f"{operation_id!r} committed event is malformed"
1530	                )
1531	            committed_record = {
1532	                "operation_id": operation_id,
1533	                "asset_id": asset_id,
1534	                "state": "committed",
1535	                "delta": delta,
1536	                "balance": balance,
1537	                "version": version,
1538	            }
1539	            asset_record = {"balance": balance, "version": version}
1540	            # 按事件 R 绝对补齐：即使账本已部分落盘也不重复加 delta、
1541	            # 不产生重复 version
1542	            self._store.commit_asset_operation(
1543	                wallet_id,
1544	                operation_id,
1545	                committed_record,
1546	                asset_id,
1547	                asset_record,
1548	            )
1549	            self._store.delete_asset_commit_intent(wallet_id, operation_id)
1550	            return committed_record
1551	
1552	        # 事件未持久化：提交未生效，凭意图记录的提交前快照把操作恢复为
1553	        # pending、资产恢复提交前 balance/version（意图已在方法入口通过
1554	        # 严格校验，标识/整数/守恒均可信）。提交前不存在该资产条目时
